camps.description: Calcasieu Area Council's 283-acre camp in southern Beauregard Parish between DeQuincy and Ragley, ~30 min from Lake Charles. 14 campsites, archery/rifle/shotgun ranges, 250-person dining hall. Hosts council resident summer camp (held annually in June), year-round unit camping, and the council's Cypress Knee Cub Scout day camp. Specific 2026 resident-camp session dates not cleanly published on the council site.
camps.name: Camp Edgewood
